title: Level-k quasi-Hamiltonian prequantization criterion for the prescribed-conjugacy-class PU(p) surface component, p an odd prime, with orbifold descent at regular identity value
author: Derek Krepski
source_title: Prequantization of the Moduli Space of Flat PU(p)-Bundles with Prescribed Boundary Holonomies
difficulty_reason: The proof separates the lifted component into ordinary conjugacy factors and a finite central quotient of barycentric conjugacy classes. It computes invariant flag-manifold cohomology and the mod-two Stiefel-Whitney obstruction on that quotient, then combines the resulting torsion cancellation with fusion and relative integral cohomology to obtain a necessary and sufficient level criterion.

source_boundary_note: Full original Theorem 5.8 level-k prequantization criterion and regular-value descent are retained for p>2 prime with all prescribed covering conjugacy classes, product-one stabilizer quotient Gamma and genus h>=0. The complete new central alcove action, component decomposition and barycentric real/mod-two finite-quotient cohomology argument are bundled; all quasi-Hamiltonian, relative-integral and fusion conventions are supplied. The previously proved h-dual moment-map identity equal to W3 and standard relative/fusion prequantization facts remain cited established prerequisites. The final regular-value conclusion is orbifold prequantization, not a coarse-space ordinary line-bundle claim. The SU(4) original illustrative diagram is retained as an asset; unused exceptional E6/E7 tables are excluded.
